description: Convert one Make (Integromat) scenario blueprint (the .json from Export Blueprint) into an n8n workflow. Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere. Writes <scenario name>.n8n.json (import it in n8n), plus the report as Markdown and JSON, to outputDir. Returns the report: totals (converted / to review / manual), every step with its n8n node and status, a concrete suggestion for each step to finish by hand, the credentials and webhook URLs to set up, and the paths of the files. For Zapier exports use convert_zapier instead. Afterwards, upload_to_n8n (when configured) creates the workflow in n8n, and check_n8n_workflow re-checks a file after manual edits.

json.description: The full contents of the exported file, when the user pasted or attached it instead of giving a path. Give either path or json, not both.

outputDir.description: Folder to write the results to; created if missing; existing files are kept and the new ones get " (2)", " (3)"… in their name. Default: Documents/migrate-to-n8n in the home folder.

path.description: Absolute path of the exported file on this computer (~ is the home folder). Give either path or json, not both.

name: convert_make
title: Convert a Make scenario to n8n
